lines.zh: 我扛着弩，蹦过沼泽的水洼。
lines.en: Crossbow on my back, I hop across the marsh pools.
Hop by hop, mud splashing my knees.
I duck low and push through the reeds.
There are lamps in the frog village. I see them.
I take the hard path on purpose.
A trail of prints in the wet ground.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把弩往上提了提。
lines.en: I stop and hitch the crossbow higher.

lines.zh: 喉咙鼓了一下，没出声，不在叫。
lines.en: My throat swells once. No sound. Not a call.
I go around the light and keep to the dark.

lines.zh: 脚趾张得很开，抓得住滑地。
lines.en: My toes spread wide for the slick ground.

lines.zh: 前面那座桥，得从下面过。
lines.en: That bridge ahead — I'll pass beneath it.
Step by step, I near the wall.
The reeds are too tall. They block my view.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，听村里的动静。
lines.en: I crouch and listen to the village.

lines.zh: 我靠着一根木桩，歇一下。
lines.en: I lean on a post and rest.
The string's loose. I tighten it.
The marsh fog comes in layers.
I count the lamps in the village.
A low croak in my throat. Quiet.
Once it's dark, this gets easier.
I oiled the crossbow; the damp will not seize it.
The water here is murky.
I check every bolt.

lines.zh: 我的皮上有斑点，很难看清。
lines.en: My spotted skin is hard to see.
Frogs calling far off. My kin.

lines.zh: 风从村里吹来，带着饭味。
lines.en: Wind from the village carries cooking smells.
I squat in the mud without moving.

lines.zh: 手指在弩机上，慢慢松开。
lines.en: My finger eases off the trigger.
Are you here to guard the village too?
Then stay out of my line.

lines.zh: 我的弩对着村口，不对着你。
lines.en: My crossbow points at the gate, not at you.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正好在我射界里。
lines.en: You're standing right in my field of fire.
Move. I need to watch over there.

lines.zh: 你手上有武器，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You're armed. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 蛙村的人认识我，你不认识。
lines.en: The village frogs know me. You don't.

lines.zh: 你的肩宽，正好配一支箭。
lines.en: Your shoulder breadth matches one bolt exactly.
Don't shout. It would alert them.
If you're helping, stand behind me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，看得清你。
lines.en: My eyes are big. I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你退三步，我就当你没来过。
lines.en: Back up three steps and I'll pretend you never came.

lines.zh: 这村子还轮不到外人来管。
lines.en: This village isn't for outsiders to run.
Why aren't you speaking?
I'm waiting for you to move.
My finger is on the trigger.
I fall back, bow still up.
My skin is thin. That drew blood.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，往芦苇里挪。
lines.en: I flatten and slide toward the reeds.
My reloading hand shakes.
The pain makes my throat pulse.
I clutch the bow against my chest.
I can't squat anymore. I go prone.
Now my shoulder won't lift.
I can still shoot. Just slower.
Stay back. I can still pull the trigger.
Will this buy me a bolt?
I'll keep it for the night watch.
Leave it on the ground. Don't hand it to me.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的东西，我吃得惯。
lines.en: I'm used to marsh food.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，眼睛还盯着村口。
lines.en: I bite it without looking away from the gate.
A full belly keeps the hand steady.
Better than bugs.
Do your village frogs eat this too?
Half for me, half for you.

lines.zh: 等打完这一场，我再好好吃。
lines.en: After this fight I'll eat properly.
You knocked my crossbow.
Don't crowd me. This bow is drawn.
I nearly fell into the water.
We brushed past and mud sprayed.
Back off. Stand on my left.
That spoiled my aim.
Your foot is on mine.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，弩没掉。
lines.en: I blocked with an arm. The bow held.
Don't touch my quiver.
Make way. I need a new position.
Not the time for this.
After this night's watch.
Are you this ugly too?
My kind doesn't fuss over this.
Just crouch beside me.
Quiet. Something's moving in the village.
Surviving matters more than anything.

lines.zh: 等仗打完，还有的是时间。
lines.en: When the fighting's done there'll be time.

lines.zh: 我把最后一支箭留给你。
lines.en: I'll save the last bolt for you.
Don't die before me.
I pick it up and drop it in my quiver.
This one's snapped. Useless.
Anything still good, I keep.
Dropped ones make good resupply.

lines.zh: 我把弩架在膝上，腾手去捡。
lines.en: I rest the bow on my knee and reach down.
Heavy. It'll crush a toe.
Yours? Take it.
I weigh it. Usable.
I hide it under a plank.
I'll remember this spot.
A shape over there. I raise the crossbow.
I settle it into the sights.

lines.zh: 它没察觉，我的准星还稳着。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed. My aim holds.
The wind's fine.
I inhale slowly and hold.

lines.zh: 它走一步，我的准星跟一步。
lines.en: It steps; my aim follows.

lines.zh: 这么远，得算上一点提前量。
lines.en: At this range, I lead the shot.

lines.zh: 村里的灯还在，说明没打进去。
lines.en: Lamps still lit in the village. They haven't broken in.
I'll take its leg first.
Don't rush me. I'm waiting for it to settle.
I lie prone, the bow braced on a mound.

lines.zh: 它往左走，我把弩移过去。
lines.en: It walks left; I move the bow.
It's behind the tree. I wait.
I count its steps.

lines.zh: 这一箭不中，我还有下一支。
lines.en: If this misses, there's another.
Breath and sights steady together.

lines.zh: 它开始急了，这是好机会。
lines.en: It's getting impatient. That's my opening.
I hold the trigger, waiting for a line of sight.
It raised its head.
The bolt goes now.
I pull the trigger.

lines.zh: 弩箭飞出去，擦过它的肩。
lines.en: The bolt flies and grazes its shoulder.

lines.zh: 一箭不中，我立刻装第二支。
lines.en: A miss. I nock another at once.
At this range, no aiming.
I club it with the stock.

lines.zh: 它冲过来，我退一步再射。
lines.en: It charges; I step back and shoot.
This bolt is for the village.
It's hit and still moving.
One more, point blank.
Reloading takes time. Don't press me.
I rise out of the reeds.
Bow strung, I hop onto the bank.

lines.zh: 雾里先出现的是我的眼睛。
lines.en: My eyes show through the fog first.
This marsh is my ground.

lines.zh: 村里的灯还没灭，来得及。
lines.en: The village lamps are still lit. In time.
I crouch and check the wall top.
Mud slides off my legs.
My kin wait on the far side.

lines.zh: 喉咙里一声闷响，是集合。
lines.en: A muffled croak — assembly.
I lower myself and set out.

lines.zh: 火燎过来，我的皮开始发亮。
lines.en: Fire swept in; my skin turns glossy.

lines.zh: 我从墙上掉下去，摔得翻了身。
lines.en: I fell off the wall and landed on my back.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进喉咙，我呛住了。
lines.en: Muddy water down my throat. I choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的泥，把我埋了半截。
lines.en: The blast threw mud that half-buried me.
An arrow is in my leg.
That light has ruined my aim.
Too long without food. I can't hold the bow up.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我跳了一下就麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; I jerked once and went numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，也没有芦苇。
lines.en: No ground here, and no reeds.
